Two flavor-text lines (idx147 Guess I will go enjoy the sights.../idx167 Might be nice to spend time with Haruka...) are Ryoma inner-monologue tips; translated in casual period-appropriate voice without modern loanwords, no explicit pronoun needed (Thai drops subject). All other 248 keys are priority-3 system/menu/item/farming/fishing/PSN text, translated in modern Thai per rule (priority 2/3/5 uses current-day Thai). {d_value} yen (2 occurrences) NOT translated as "yen" per glossary section on yen/circle in Bakumatsu setting -- filled tentatively as "{d_value} เรียว" (locked era currency ryo) for QC to pass non-empty, FLAGGED for lead confirmation since this may be a reused engine placeholder from modern-day minigames rather than genuine in-fiction currency. New shop name coined: Kurogane Smithing (くろがね屋) = ร้านตีเหล็กคุโรงาเนะ (transliterated proper name + descriptor, matching Teradaya/Omiya pattern). New mode names coined: Another Life (アナザーライフ) = อีกชีวิตหนึ่ง; Battle Dungeon (バトルダンジョン) = แดนประลองการต่อสู้; Bakumatsu Premium Adventure = โหมดผจญภัยพิเศษบาคุมัตสึ; Scarecrow Chateau (かかし屋敷) = คฤหาสน์หุ่นไล่กา; Ultimate Challenge = ศึกท้าทายสูงสุด. "Title" (character title/badge system) = ฉายา (no prior TM). "Seal" (印, equipment enhancement item) = ตรา (short form matching existing ตราเหลี่ยม/ตรากลม glossary pattern). Aizawa (relative/Kuroki/Kurosawa/Kuroda side-NPCs, not in name_locks.json) transliterated: Aizawa=อาอิซาวะ (Kuroki/Kurosawa/Kuroda already had ref_tm, used as-is).
